title: An Offer for Lyova and Denis's Secret

scenes.title: Time to Tell Everything
scenes.summary: Denis and Katya agree to tell Sveta and Nikita the truth about their relationship right after going to the cinema.

scenes.title: Dish from the Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: Restaurateur Alexander Tumanov praises Lyova's dish and offers him the head chef job at his new restaurant project.

scenes.title: A Tip with a Phone Number
scenes.summary: The kitchen staff learns about Lyova's job offer on the banknote, and Lyova tells Chef Barinov about the coincidence.

scenes.title: Quarrel with the Chef
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov flies into a rage when Lyova says he modified his recipe, provoking Lyova to write a letter of resignation.

scenes.title: Lonely Dad and a Russian Lesson
scenes.summary: Nastya urges Kostya to find a girlfriend for his lonely father, while Eleonora corrects Kostya's Russian grammar.

scenes.title: A Cork in the Eye
scenes.summary: Katya and Denis try to confess the truth to Nikita and Sveta, but a flying champagne cork hits Sveta in the eye.

scenes.title: The Third Resignation Letter
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov stalls Lyova by making him rewrite his resignation letter three times, while Timofey visits Kostya at the bar.

scenes.title: Allergy at the Hospital
scenes.summary: Nastya tells Kostya to find out his father's taste in women, while Sveta suffers an allergic reaction at the hospital.

scenes.title: Call to the Restaurateur
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Tumanov to talk him out of hiring Lyova, but Lyova catches him in the act and Tumanov is even more impressed.

scenes.title: Meeting at the Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya tries to set his father up with a woman named Valentina at the bar, but she thinks Kostya is hitting on her himself.

scenes.title: The Blindfolded Challenge
scenes.summary: Lyova confronts Chef Barinov about the phone call and challenges him to a blindfolded cooking duel in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Return from the Hospital
scenes.summary: Denis brings a self-conscious Sveta back from the hospital, while Nastya arranges for her mother to bring a single friend home for Timofey.

scenes.title: The Culinary Duel
scenes.summary: Senya pokes tiny holes in Chef Barinov's blindfold to protect his bet as the blindfolded cooking duel with Lyova begins.

scenes.title: Duel Results and Sveta's Parents
scenes.summary: Elena declares Lyova the winner of the duel after exposing Chef Barinov's blindfold, while Sveta introduces Denis to her parents.

scenes.title: The Encounter in the Apartment
scenes.summary: Kostya finds his father in the bathroom with housekeeper Anzhelika right as Nastya arrives with her mother's single friend.

scenes.title: Other People's Business and the Order
scenes.summary: Kostya tells Nastya to stop meddling in his father's love life, while Sveta's parents order Katya's molecular cuisine dish.

scenes.title: Confession in Front of Parents
scenes.summary: During Katya's table-side cooking presentation, Denis tells Sveta and her parents that his true love is someone else.

scenes.title: The Chef's Apology
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov interrupts Lyova's meeting with Tumanov to sincerely apologize and praise Lyova as the best chef he knows.

scenes.title: Lyova's Decision
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov admits Lyova is his closest friend, and with Gulya's support, Lyova turns down Tumanov's contract to stay.

scenes.title: An Honest Conversation
scenes.summary: Lyova confesses that his blindfold was slightly transparent, while Katya admits to Denis that Nikita left on a business trip before she could tell him.
